title: NPC services: fences, banks, hirelings and tailors
summary: More NPCs can offer services, and some open screens you already use.
items: A fence opens their shop's Sell tab while the black market is open, at the fence's buy rate.
A bank opens the loan request with the bank named; the DM starts from that bank's terms.
Ask an agent for hired hands to propose a staff contract for one of the party's properties.
Tailors make clothes over approved downtime; bring your own cloth to pay less.
